title: The working-directory delete half and the two breakaway gaps are settled by a recorded Windows run
goal: A recorded Windows run settles what SP-5x5ut5ko could only narrow (review gap G1, ST-tjaxw22f and ST-24m3pttf): the error RemoveDirectory or a recursive delete returns on a directory a live process has as its working directory, and whether a tree is left partly deleted; what CreateProcess does with CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB inside a job without JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_BREAKAWAY_OK; and whether the flag acts on the created process. The facts are written through /kb-refresh tagged by what they rest on, and the three kb/public/_gaps.md entries get a dated Resolved note, or stay narrowed with what the run still lacks.

run: import sys;t=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ks=('Which error a rename or delete returns','when the caller\u0027s job does not allow breakaway','acts on the process being created');bs=[t.split(k,1)[1].split('\n- **',1)[0] if k in t else '' for k in ks];ok=[b.count('Resolved 2026-')>0 for b in bs];print('entries resolved:',ok);sys.exit(0 if all(ok) else 1)
